{{Top|leg}}
'''Sleep''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to cause an individual within their line of sight to fall [[Sleep/Legends|asleep]].

Ascendants who wished to cast the spell were required to know the [[detect life]] and [[sense life]] spells.
